newsitem.title: USA: Southern National/United Carolina merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Southern National/United Carolina merger approved.

text.p: The U.S. Justice Department said Tuesday it approved the proposed merger of Southern National Corp and United Carolina Bancshares after they agreed to sell 20 branch offices.

The Justice Department's antitrust division said the banks agreed to divest 15 United Carolina branch offices and five Southern National branch offices. The branch offices have total deposits of about $488 million.
Department officials said the divestiture will resolve concerns the merger would have lessened competition in certain North Carolina markets.
They said the proposed merger still must be approved by the Federal Reserve Board.
